descriptions.w3d_h1_deque_destroy_nodes_803535b4: Releases every non-null buffer in the deque node range [start, finish).
descriptions.w3d_h1_deque_base_destroy_80353604: Deque base destructor: if the node map at offset 36 exists, releases the buffers from the start node through the finish node and then the map; deletes the object when flag bit 0 is set.
descriptions.w3d_h1_deque_next_buffer_8035eec4: Releases the iterator's current buffer and advances it to the next node, setting first, last (first + 128) and cur.
descriptions.w3d_h1_deque_destroy_nodes_8035ed6c: Second instance of 0x803535b4: releases every non-null buffer in the node range.
descriptions.w3d_h1_deque_base_destroy_8035edbc: Second instance of 0x80353604: deque base destructor releasing node buffers and the map, deleting the object when flag bit 0 is set.
